also: you’re just putting on a bold front

terms.comment: Literally “boldness is held as a wall”. In Sallust, Catiline tells his men that in danger daring serves as a rampart; the sentence does not say that the boldness is only put on, which is how Traupman uses it.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
